title: Storage Lot Charge Through a Statement Date — Kestrel Pre-Owned Retail Calculation
content:
**Recovery & Remarketing calculation sheet — storage charge, Kestrel Pre-Owned Retail Installment Sale Contract**

**Definition.** The storage charge through a statement date is the daily storage fee for the tier times the billable days, rounded to the cent.

- **Billable days** are the stored days less the free days for the tier, never below zero.
- **Stored days** are counted from the day after the repossession date through the statement date, both included.
- The repossession date and the recovery type (involuntary recovery or voluntary surrender) are read from the contract; the daily storage fee and the free days are the figures of the tier on the product's recovery charges rate card.

**Order of assembly.** Any replacement of a figure comes first; the daily amounts are then added together, their sum is multiplied by the billable days, and the charge is rounded to the cent once, at the end.

### Worked illustration (hypothetical figures)

| Input | Value |
|---|---|
| Repossession date | the 1st of a month |
| Statement date | the 12th of the same month |
| Daily storage fee (illustrative) | $20.00 |
| Free days (illustrative) | 2 |

Stored days: the 2nd through the 12th, both included, are 11 days. Billable days: 11 less 2, that is 9. Charge: $20.00 times 9, that is $180.00. With a statement date on the 2nd the stored days are 1, the billable days are 0 (never below zero), and the charge is $0.00. The fee and free days in this sheet are illustrative, not rate-card figures.
